{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Dark-wash straight-leg jeans, full length with a slight stretch, color deep indigo #2B3A55, stretch cotton denim

Fitted long-sleeve top, crew neck, hip length, color warm cream #F2E8D5, soft cotton jersey

Chunky cardigan, relaxed fit, hip length, button front, color sage green #8A9A7B, wool-blend knit

Water-resistant light jacket, straight cut, mid-hip length, color camel #B8895A, cotton twill with a soft lining

Cushioned leather sneakers, low-top, color off-white #EDE6DA, smooth leather with a thick rubber sole

Crossbody bag, compact with a zip closure, color cognac #9A5B34, grained leather

Soft scarf, wide and lightly draped, color muted teal #5F8A85, fine wool-cotton blend

Ankle socks, cushioned, color cream #F2E8D5, cotton blend

Why this outfit works: A day of nine hours on cobblestones in cool autumn air calls for comfort first, and the cushioned sneakers and stretch denim keep you moving easily from morning to evening. The layers of top, cardigan and jacket let you adjust as the temperature changes, and the jacket also covers you against a light breeze even though no rain is expected. The warm cream, sage and camel tones flatter your golden hair and warm skin, while the muted teal scarf echoes your grey-green eyes. The crossbody bag keeps your hands free for photos and sightseeing."}
